scope.source_definition: Cables used to supply electricity that are suspended between pylons.

transform.unit_of_observation: one original OS ID, with clipped/grid-square parts grouped as LineString or MultiLineString
transform.projection: Inverse British National Grid on Airy 1830, then the standard seven-parameter OSGB36-to-WGS84 Helmert transform.
transform.projection_accuracy_note: The Helmert transform can differ from OSTN15 by several metres. It is appropriate for the generalized 1:10,000 web context layer, not cadastral or survey use.
transform.geometry: No simplification, smoothing or inferred connectivity. Coordinates rounded to six decimal degrees. Identical parts are deduplicated and line direction is canonicalized.
transform.voltage: OS OpenMap Local publishes no numeric voltage; VOLTAGE_KV is intentionally null.

property_schema.ORIGINAL_ID: Original OS UUID from the Shapefile ID field.
property_schema.VOLTAGE_KV: Always null because voltage is not published.
property_schema.GEOMETRY_CONFIDENCE: Source scale, CRS transform, precision and simplification note.

steps: Verify OS product ID and pinned 2026-04 version.
Select the GB ESRI Shapefile archive from the downloads API.
Read the remote ZIP by byte range or verify a complete local ZIP.
Read and CRC/SHA-256 verify only ElectricityTransmissionLine members.
Validate DBF ID/FEATCODE and EPSG:27700 Shapefile schemas.
Group clipped parts by the original OS UUID.
Transform BNG vertices to WGS84 and round to six decimals.
Write atomically and reparse to verify hash, count and bounds.
